prompt_text: Who is the best roofer in Denver for hail damage repair?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — but “best” depends on where in Denver you are and whether you need help with an insurance claim, what roofing materials you have, and whether it’s residential or commercial. A safer next step is for me to give a short, practical checklist and then I can recommend specific roofers if you tell me your zip code and whether you want a company that works with insurance claims.

Quick checklist for picking the best roofer for hail damage
- Get at least 3 written estimates from local roofers experienced with hail/storm claims.
- Check reviews and complaints (Google, BBB, Angi, Yelp, Houzz). Look for recent storm-repair jobs in Denver.
- Verify contractor insurance (liability and workers’ comp) and local business license.
- Prefer roofers with manufacturer certifications (GAF, CertainTeed, Owens Corning, IKO) — that helps with material warranties.
- Ask for references and photos of recent hail repairs nearby.
- Make sure they help with insurance paperwork if you want that; clarify whether they’ll meet the adjuster and provide a scope of loss.
- Watch out for “storm chasers” who solicit door-to-door immediately after a storm. Demand local address and stable business history.
- Confirm written warranty on workmanship and on materials, and get a lien release when job is paid.
- Ask about mitigation (temporary tarping) and how they handle tear-off and disposal permits.

Useful questions to ask each roofer
- How many hail-damage roofs have you repaired in Denver in the last year?
- Are you certified with major shingle manufacturers? Which ones?
- Do you handle the insurance claim/adjuster coordination? Is there an extra fee?
- What is your timeline and project process? Who is the main contact?
- Can you provide recent local references and photos?

If you want, tell me:
- Your zip code or neighborhood
- Residential or commercial
- Whether you want the company to handle the insurance claim

I’ll then suggest several reputable, highly reviewed contractors in your area and point out any pros/cons for each.
